sentences.text: 2.The matter came up for hearing on 05.02.2025 and this Court passed the following order:
Mr.P.Sathish, learned Additional Government Pleader takes notice for the respondents 1, 3 and 5.
Mrs.S.Vanitha Joice Rani, learned standing counsel takes notice for the 2nd respondent.
Mrs.Vasanthamala, learned standing counsel (CMWSS) takes notice for the 4th respondent.

2.The main grievance that has been expressed by the petitioner is that an extent of nearly 24484.4 sq. ft. has been taken away for laying a channel and no compensation has been https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 09/04/2025 01:19:37 pm ) paid to the petitioner.
The representation made by the petitioner in this regard was also not properly dealt with and it is alleged that each authority is pointing the finger on the other and as a result, till date no compensation has been paid.
3.There shall be a direction to the counsel appearing on behalf of the respondents to take written instructions and place the same before this Court.
Post this writ petition under the caption " for orders" on 05.03.2025.
3.The matter was once again listed for hearing on 05.03.2025 and the following order was passed by this Court:
Pursuant to the earlier order passed on 05.02.2025, written instructions have been given by the 5th respondent.
On going through the same, it is now clear that the respondents have identified water resources department to be the authority who has to pay the compensation to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the Chief Engineer, Water Resources Department, Chepauk, Chennai and the Executive Engineer, Water Resources Department, Kosasthalaiyar Basin Division, Tiruvallur, are impleased as respondents 6 and 7 in this writ petition.

3.The learned

Additional Government Pleader submitted that the Manapakkam Channel has been constructed in the subject property and the land plan schedule for the administrative sanction proposal has been received by the th concerned authority from the impleaded 7 respondent through th communication dated 13.02.2025.
On receipt of the same, the 5 respondent has initiated proceedings for getting the administrative sanction proposal for land acquisition process.

Kosasthalaiyar Basin Division, Thiruvallur (Requisition Body) vide letter No.
1/2.3.1/-28 (L&A) / 2025/63 M, dated 30.01.2025.

02.04.2025)

04.04.2025 7)

Further, it is respectfully submitted that the prayer of the petitioner in this writ petition has already been taken and steps has been initiatedunder The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (RFCTLARR) Act, 2013 in due process.
